codes.SUPPLIER_NOT_MATCHED: 등록된 거래처와 연결되지 않아 견적을 저장하지 못했어요.
codes.SUPPLIER_MISMATCH: 메일에 연결된 거래처와 견적의 업체가 달라 확인이 필요해요.
codes.MISSING_FIELD: 견적을 저장하는 데 필요한 필수 정보가 없어 검토를 보류했어요.
codes.MISSING_EVIDENCE: 견적 정보의 원문 근거를 확인할 수 없어 검토를 보류했어요.
codes.SOURCE_READ_FAILED: 메일이나 첨부의 내용을 읽을 수 없어 검토를 보류했어요.
codes.NO_QUOTE_DATA: 메일에서 검토할 수 있는 견적 정보를 찾지 못했어요.
codes.CONDITIONS_MISSING: 검토에 필요한 요청 조건이 부족해 확인이 필요해요.
codes.NO_SUITABLE_CANDIDATES: 요청 조건에 맞는 거래처 후보를 찾지 못했어요.
codes.SEND_POLICY_REQUIRED: 견적 요청에 필요한 발송 설정을 확인해야 해요.
codes.HOLD_REASON_UNAVAILABLE: 보류 사유를 확인할 수 없어 담당자 확인이 필요해요.

missing_field_messages.supplier_name: 업체명이 확인되지 않아 견적을 저장하지 못했어요.
missing_field_messages.unit_price: 견적 단가가 확인되지 않아 검토를 보류했어요.
missing_field_messages.unit: 견적의 단위가 확인되지 않아 검토를 보류했어요.
missing_field_messages.quantity: 요청 수량이 확인되지 않아 검토를 보류했어요.

rules: Only ON_HOLD returns hold; other steps return null.
Read only verified owner, current input_revision and current_batch_id completed AGENT runs.
Latest completed run takes precedence; never reuse stale holds.
Legacy reason is normalized to fixed templates, never forwarded. Unknown reason uses HOLD_REASON_UNAVAILABLE.
Exception to frontend-copy ownership: hold.message is safe server-owned display copy.
Public read endpoints use fixed text and do not expose model text or internal fields.

graph_extraction.database_checks: Verify service-role access, live claim, owner, case, extraction run, batch, revision and mail membership. Deduplicate identical evidence and acknowledge with true. Confirm deployed signature and acknowledgement with KAN-133.
graph_extraction.priority: One acknowledged supplier rejection code from this role run overrides agent output. Conflicting acknowledged codes fall back to HOLD_REASON_UNAVAILABLE. Otherwise use the closed structured hold.code, then legacy reason extraction. DB remains authoritative for supplier codes and must verify stored evidence.
graph_extraction.reason_storage: Role finish receives the original reason in p_output.reason. KAN-133 must preserve it before normalization in a restricted internal record keyed by run, expose it only to authorized internal staff and retain fixed public copy. The graph completion payload omits the original HOLD reason.
